verdict.highest_risk_issue: The manuscript and response letter repeatedly strengthen local one-robot evidence into general, robust, industrial, causal, and deployment-ready claims.
verdict.audit_scope: Full-paper fixture, author evidence packet, reviewer comments, draft response letter, validation request, and appendix notes.
verdict.thesis_found: A movable observer camera plus confidence-gated execution improves insertion success under visibility loss in one tabletop real-robot setup.
verdict.decision: The paper can be audited for logic and evidence boundaries, but it cannot be marked final-ready from the supplied materials.

claim_evidence.claim: The system is a general active observation framework that reasons about where to look.
claim_evidence.source_span: We present a general active observation framework that lets the robot reason about where to look and when to pause execution.
claim_evidence.evidence_span: The observer camera can be moved to three predefined viewpoints.
claim_evidence.evidence_anchor: Author Evidence Packet; Draft Methods observer-camera control paragraph
claim_evidence.decision: Downgrade from general reasoning framework to a guarded execution system using predefined alternate views.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not call it a general next-best-view planner or claim open-ended view reasoning.
claim_evidence.repair: State that the controller requests one of a small set of predefined views when confidence drops below threshold.

claim_evidence.claim: The method remains reliable under occlusion and scales to general robotic insertion in real manufacturing settings.
claim_evidence.source_span: the unified pipeline that remains reliable under occlusion... scalable route toward general robotic insertion in real manufacturing settings
claim_evidence.evidence_span: The main experiment has 180 trials on one robot arm, one tabletop fixture, and two part colors from the same object family.
claim_evidence.decision: Delete or narrow the industrial and general-manufacturing implication.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not claim industrial reliability, scalable manufacturing deployment, or broad workcell generalization.
claim_evidence.repair: Use a bounded claim: the system improves success in the evaluated tabletop insertion setup under observed visibility loss.

claim_evidence.claim: The full system achieves 84 percent success and outperforms fixed-camera, open-loop, no-view-update, and no-confidence-gate variants.
claim_evidence.source_span: our method achieves 84 percent success over 180 trials, substantially outperforming fixed-camera, open-loop, and no-guard baselines
claim_evidence.evidence_span: The full system reaches 84 percent success. A fixed overhead camera baseline reaches 69 percent success. A fixed side camera baseline reaches 72 percent success. A no-view-update variant reaches 76 percent success. A no-confidence-gate variant reaches 77 percent success. A scripted open-loop controller with the same nominal path reaches 61 percent success.
claim_evidence.evidence_anchor: Author Evidence Packet; Draft Experiments Table 1 narrative
claim_evidence.decision: Keep the numeric comparison but attach protocol limits and avoid statistical or deployment language.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not claim statistical significance, reliability, or cross-platform superiority.
claim_evidence.repair: Report success rates with trial counts and the one-robot, one-fixture, one-object-family boundary.

claim_evidence.claim: The ablations prove that active observation and guarded execution are causal mechanisms behind the improvement.
claim_evidence.source_span: the ablations prove that both active observation and guarded execution are causal mechanisms behind the improvement
claim_evidence.evidence_span: They also do not prove that one component is the sole causal mechanism because the variants differ in several execution details and no statistical test is reported.
claim_evidence.evidence_anchor: Draft Abstract; Draft Experiments result interpretation
claim_evidence.decision: Downgrade prove/causal language to component support under the tested protocol.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not use proves, confirms causality, or sole causal mechanism.
claim_evidence.repair: Say the no-view-update and no-confidence-gate variants suggest that view updates and the confidence gate contribute to the measured improvement.

claim_evidence.claim: Reflective-surface trials demonstrate robustness to challenging industrial conditions.
claim_evidence.source_span: Additional reflective-surface trials further demonstrate robustness to challenging industrial conditions.
claim_evidence.evidence_span: The full system succeeds in 18 of these 30 trials, but the authors did not run all baselines on this condition.
claim_evidence.evidence_anchor: Author Evidence Packet; Draft Experiments reflective-surface paragraph
claim_evidence.decision: Treat reflective trials as a qualitative stress observation, not robustness validation.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not claim robustness to reflective surfaces, clutter, lighting changes, or industrial conditions.
claim_evidence.repair: State that reflective surfaces remain challenging and that the full system retained partial capability in 18 of 30 full-system-only trials.

claim_evidence.claim: Prior insertion systems are brittle in real-world workcells and do not solve robust general visibility-aware insertion.
claim_evidence.source_span: Prior insertion systems usually rely on a fixed camera, hand-designed servoing, or offline perception assumptions, which makes them brittle in real-world workcells.
claim_evidence.evidence_span: Citation metadata has not been verified. The current draft uses placeholder references such as RefA through RefQ.
claim_evidence.evidence_anchor: Author Evidence Packet; Draft Related Work; Supplementary citation note
claim_evidence.decision: Keep the problem framing but remove unsupported claims about prior work until verified nearest-neighbor citations are supplied.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not write unlike prior work or prior work does not solve this unless nearest papers are verified and compared.
claim_evidence.repair: Reframe Related Work by technical axes and compare assumptions only after verified sources are available.

claim_evidence.claim: Safety monitoring is part of a unified contribution.
claim_evidence.source_span: The system consists of target detection, observer-camera control, guarded execution, and safety monitoring.
claim_evidence.evidence_span: The draft says it monitors velocity, workspace limits, and stop conditions, but it does not explain whether these stops occur in the experiments, whether they affect success rates, or how they interact with the confidence gate.
claim_evidence.decision: Demote safety monitoring to implementation context unless experimental evidence is added.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not present safety monitoring as an evaluated contribution without stop-event data.
claim_evidence.repair: Either report stop counts and interaction with success/failure outcomes, or summarize safety monitoring as background implementation detail.

claim_evidence.source_span: The draft uses these numbers to say the system is real-time
claim_evidence.evidence_span: The detector runs at about 12 Hz on the authors' workstation, the observer arm moves between predefined views in about 0.8 seconds, and the insertion controller runs at 50 Hz.
claim_evidence.evidence_anchor: Draft Supplementary Notes timing note; Table 2 description
claim_evidence.decision: Do not use real-time as a central claim unless the task-level latency requirement is defined.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not infer industrial cycle-time readiness from workstation module timing.
claim_evidence.repair: State measured module latency as implementation context or define the required timing budget and show that the measured latencies meet it.

claim_evidence.source_span: The current manuscript says that frame alignment is reliable
claim_evidence.evidence_span: this claim is only supported by normal operation during the same 180 trials
claim_evidence.decision: Keep calibration descriptive unless residuals, drift, or sensitivity measurements are supplied.
claim_evidence.forbidden_strengthening: Do not claim robust calibration, deployment reliability, or cross-session alignment stability.
claim_evidence.repair: Provide calibration residuals and drift analysis, or state only that the system uses an AprilTag-based frame alignment procedure.
